# FDGD019

> PERMITTED: Changing a `ref struct` to a (Non-`ref`) `struct`

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section D.6.13 Changing a ref struct to a (Non-ref) struct.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: draft

It cannot be safely undone: changing back is FDGD018. PublicApiAnalyzers (optional in /fdg-setup) can flag changes to the public API.

## From the book

There are no compile or runtime changes from changing a `ref struct` to a “regular” `struct`. However, undoing the change later would be a breaking change, as described in section D.6.12.

The .NET BCL team considers this an acceptable change, but would warn you that it cannot be safely undone.
